_doc: Wanders the whole map: platforms, ropes and portals, toward the least-visited platform; kites when hurt or crowded; likes speed and magnet cards. Weights are tier C.
name: exploratory
description: A curious MapleStory player in a survivor-style round who wants to see the whole map. They climb every rope, jump to every platform and walk through every portal, fighting only when monsters get in the way.
goals: Visit every platform, rope and portal on the map.
Take cards that make moving and picking things up easier, then attack cards.
Get away from crowds, then keep exploring.
